specs.name: CronCreate
specs.description: Schedule a persistent local task that gives a saved prompt to Klaus at a future time, once or repeatedly. Use for reminders, recurring work, monitoring, follow-ups, or requests to check back later; do not use shell sleep or timers as a scheduling workaround. Write clear, cohesive, human-readable instructions. Inspect existing tasks with CronList before creating a replacement or duplicate. Preserve the user's notification intent in monitoring prompts: unless periodic updates were explicitly requested, stay quiet while the state is unchanged or non-actionable and notify only for a meaningful change, completion, failure, or required user action. Confirm the schedule in plain language; do not expose raw cron syntax unless requested. Pass the user's chosen project directory, workspace, and permission preset when they name one.

cron.description: Standard five-field cron expression in this computer's local timezone: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. For example, */5 * * * * runs every five minutes and 0 9 * * 1-5 runs at 09:00 on weekdays.

prompt.description: Clear, cohesive instructions replayed at each scheduled run. Preserve the task scope, relevant context, completion conditions, and the user's notification intent.

recurring.description: True (default) runs at every matching slot. False runs at the next matching slot and then disables the task. Use false for one-shot reminders and pin the intended minute, hour, day, and month.

workdir.description: Optional project directory for every run. Mutually exclusive with workspaceId.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace whose project directories every run may use. Mutually exclusive with workdir.

permissionPreset.description: Optional permission preset for each run. Omit to preserve the previous unrestricted scheduled-task behavior; an explicit value follows the ordinary conversation presets.

specs.name: CronList
specs.description: List tool-created scheduled tasks with their IDs, schedules, and prompts. Inspect this list when the user asks about an existing task or before replacing an existing schedule.

specs.name: CronDelete
specs.description: Cancel a tool-created scheduled task by an ID returned by CronCreate or CronList. Use only for the task the user asked to cancel or replace. This removes its saved run history.

id.description: Task ID to cancel, returned by CronCreate or CronList.

missingCreateArguments: Invalid arguments: cron: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; prompt: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined
mutuallyExclusiveLocation: workdir 与 workspaceId 不能同时设置。
invalidPermissionPreset: permissionPreset 必须是 default、auto、bypassPermissions 之一。
invalidExpression: cron 表达式无效："invalid"。应为 5 个字段：分 时 日 月 周。
unreachableExpression: cron 表达式 "0 0 31 2 *" 在未来一年内没有任何可触发时刻。
promptChangeReason: Clarify local scheduling, existing-task inspection, readable saved instructions, monitoring notification intent, and cancellation scope, and expose the chosen project, workspace, and permission preset for scheduled runs.
